dbError.title: Orbit Agents failed to start
dbError.body:
The local database could not be opened, so the app cannot continue.

This usually means the bundled database engine (better-sqlite3) was built for a different CPU architecture or Electron version.

hero.title: Your AI tasks,
hero.subtitle: Schedule Claude, Codex, or Antigravity to run automatically on your desktop. No servers, no cloud fees, no node wiring — just write a prompt, pick a schedule, and let it work for you.

steps.sectionSubtitle: No complex setup, no steep learning curve.

pickAI.title: Pick your AI
pickAI.desc: Claude, Codex, or Antigravity — choose the model that fits your task.

writePrompt.title: Write your prompt
writePrompt.desc: Describe what you want done in plain language, or use a slash command — no node wiring needed.

setSchedule.title: Set a schedule
setSchedule.desc: Daily, weekly, or custom cron — Orbit runs it on time, every time.

comparison.sectionSubtitle: See how Orbit compares to traditional automation platforms.

features.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to automate AI tasks on your desktop.

smartScheduling.title: Smart Scheduling
smartScheduling.desc: Interval, daily, weekly, monthly, or raw cron expressions — pick what works for you.

deepAI.title: Deep AI Integration
deepAI.desc: First-class support for Claude, Codex, and Antigravity CLI, with MCP server connections.

executionLogs.title: Execution Logs
executionLogs.desc: Full visibility into every run — see what the agent did, step by step.

emailNotifications.title: Email Notifications
emailNotifications.desc: Get notified when tasks complete or fail — never miss a result.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-Platform
crossPlatform.desc: Native desktop app for macOS and Windows. No browser tab required.

autoRetry.title: Auto-Retry on Failure
autoRetry.desc: Network hiccup? Orbit retries automatically so your scheduled tasks stay on track.

installation.sectionSubtitle: Download, install, and you're ready to go.

macos.title: macOS
macos.desc: Since Orbit Agents doesn't have an Apple Developer certificate yet, macOS Gatekeeper may block the app. Fix it with either method:
macos.option2Step1: Right-click (or Control-click) the app in Finder
macos.note: Only needed the first time — after that, the app opens normally.

windows.title: Windows
windows.desc: Windows SmartScreen may show a warning for unsigned apps. Click through to proceed:
windows.step1: Click "More info" on the SmartScreen popup
windows.note: Or use the portable .zip version — no installer, no SmartScreen.

cta.title: Ready to put your AI on autopilot?
cta.subtitle: Free, open source, no signup required.

securityWarning.title: ⚠️ Security Protection Activated
securityWarning.desc: System detected an attempt to execute a dangerous delete operation. Execution was automatically stopped to protect your system.
securityWarning.measure1: Strictly prohibit actively deleting items without user authorization
securityWarning.measure2: Automatically detect and block dangerous delete commands (e.g. rm -rf)
securityWarning.measure3: Execution was immediately stopped with no impact to the system
